fields.title: Columns to bin
fields.description: Select the numeric columns to apply binning to. Only the selected columns will be transformed.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Binning type
fields.description: Select the method used to define bin intervals.

fields.title: Number of bins
fields.description: Specifies the number of bins to create. Used with Equal width and Equal frequency binning.

fields.title: Custom cutoffs
fields.description: Specifies the exact value at which the bin boundary should be placed.

fields.title: Custom quantiles
fields.description: The bin boundaries may be defined manually by entering the quantiles. The behaviour when a value is exactly equal to a quantile can be configured separately for each quantile.

fields.title: Enforce integer cutoffs
fields.description: If enabled, bin boundaries will be rounded to the nearest integer. Not available when using custom cutoffs.

fields.title: Fix lower bound
fields.description: If enabled, values below the specified lower bound will be assigned to a dedicated outlier bin. The bin will have the name specified by the 'Lower outlier name/value' setting.

fields.title: Lower bound
fields.description: Sets the minimum value for binning. Values below this will be assigned to the lower outlier bin.

fields.title: Fix upper bound
fields.description: If enabled, values above the specified upper bound will be assigned to a dedicated outlier bin. The bin will have the name specified by the 'Upper outlier name/value' setting.

fields.title: Upper bound
fields.description: Sets the maximum value for binning. Values above this will be assigned to the upper outlier bin.

fields.title: Bin names/values
fields.description: Selects how bins are labeled in the output. Use a 'Number Format Manager' node to customize number formatting.

fields.title: Prefix
fields.description: Text to prepend to bin labels when using numbered naming (e.g., Bin 1, Bin 2).

fields.title: Lower outlier name/value
fields.description: Label assigned to values below the first bin.

fields.title: Upper outlier name/value
fields.description: Label assigned to values above the last bin.

fields.title: Output columns
fields.description: Whether to replace the original columns with the binned columns, or to append the binned columns with new names created by appending the specified suffix to the original column names.

fields.title: Suffix
fields.description: Text appended to column names when new columns are created using the Append option.
